scripts.test: pnpm --filter @video-agent/contracts test && pnpm --filter @video-agent/web test && uv run --project services/api pytest -c services/api/pyproject.toml -q
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @video-agent/web lint && uv run --project services/api ruff check services/api workers
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @video-agent/contracts check:types && pnpm --filter @video-agent/web typecheck && uv run --project services/api mypy services/api/src
scripts.format:check: pnpm --filter @video-agent/contracts format:check && pnpm --filter @video-agent/web format:check && uv run --project services/api ruff format --check services/api workers
scripts.format: pnpm --filter @video-agent/web format && uv run --project services/api ruff format services/api workers
scripts.check: pnpm run test && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run format:check
